name: Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench, grip bar slightly wider than shoulder width. Lower bar to mid-chest, then press up to full extension.

name: Incline Bench Press
instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degrees. Lower bar to upper chest, press up to full extension.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on flat bench with dumbbells at chest level. Press up, bringing dumbbells together at the top.

name: Dumbbell Chest Fly
instructions: Lie on flat bench, arms extended above chest with slight bend in elbows. Lower arms in arc until stretch is felt, return to start.

name: Cable Crossover
instructions: Stand between cable columns with handles at high position. Step forward, bring hands together in front of chest in a hugging motion.

name: Push Up
instructions: Start in plank position. Lower chest to ground, then push back up to full extension.

name: Dips
instructions: Grip parallel bars, lean slightly forward. Lower body until upper arms are parallel to ground, then press back up.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width, bar over mid-foot. Hinge at hips, grip bar. Drive through floor, extending hips and knees simultaneously.

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge forward at hips to ~45 degrees, grip bar shoulder-width. Pull bar to lower chest, squeeze shoulder blades.

name: Pull Up
instructions: Hang from bar with overhand grip. Pull chest toward bar, lower with control.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Grip bar wider than shoulders. Pull bar down to upper chest, squeezing lats. Return with control.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit upright, feet on platform. Pull handle to abdomen, squeezing shoulder blades together.

name: Dumbbell Row
instructions: Place one hand and knee on bench. Pull dumbbell to hip, keeping elbow close to body.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Set cable at face height with rope attachment. Pull toward face, externally rotating shoulders at end position.

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with bar at shoulder height. Press bar overhead to full lockout, keeping core braced.

name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at sides. Raise arms out to sides until parallel with ground, slight bend in elbows.

name: Front Raise
instructions: Stand with dumbbells in front of thighs. Raise one or both arms forward to shoulder height.

name: Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Bend forward at hips. Raise dumbbells out to sides, squeezing rear delts at the top.

name: Arnold Press
instructions: Start with dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing you. Press up while rotating palms outward to face forward at top.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand with bar at arm's length, underhand grip. Curl bar up to shoulder level, keeping elbows stationary.

name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at sides. Curl up, supinating wrist as you lift. Lower with control.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at sides, palms facing in (neutral grip). Curl up keeping neutral wrist position.

name: Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Stand at cable machine with bar/rope attachment at high position. Push down until arms are fully extended.

name: Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on bench, hold bar above chest with arms extended. Lower bar toward forehead by bending elbows, then extend.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Hold dumbbell overhead with both hands. Lower behind head by bending elbows, then extend back up.

name: Barbell Squat
instructions: Bar on upper back, feet shoulder-width. Squat down until thighs are parallel or below, drive back up.

name: Front Squat
instructions: Bar rests on front delts, elbows high. Squat down keeping torso upright, drive back up.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit in leg press, feet shoulder-width on platform. Lower platform until knees are at 90 degrees, press back up.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Sit in machine with pad on lower shins. Extend legs to full lockout, squeeze quads at top.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rear foot elevated on bench. Lower until front thigh is parallel, drive back up through front heel.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold bar at hip height. Push hips back, lowering bar along legs with slight knee bend. Feel stretch in hamstrings, return to start.

name: Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down on machine, pad behind ankles. Curl heels toward glutes, lower with control.

name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Upper back on bench, bar across hips. Drive hips up to full extension, squeezing glutes at top.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides. Step forward into lunge, lower until rear knee nearly touches ground. Step through to next rep.

name: Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on edge of platform with heels hanging off. Rise up onto toes, pause at top, lower slowly below platform level.

name: Plank
instructions: Hold body in straight line from head to heels, supported on forearms and toes. Brace core throughout.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from bar. Raise legs until parallel with ground (or higher), lower with control.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel facing cable machine with rope behind head. Crunch down, bringing elbows toward knees.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit with knees bent, lean back slightly. Rotate torso side to side, optionally holding a weight.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneel with ab wheel on floor. Roll forward extending body, then pull back using core. Keep hips from sagging.
